parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic. It is a long, narrow component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the wearer’s head, ensuring the eyeglasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint attached to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame and lens assembly of the eyeglasses, made of a metal alloy. It holds the lenses and connects to both legs via hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, holds the lenses in position, and ensures proper alignment for vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the legs rotate around its hinge joints. It does not move during normal use.
